query: SELECT e.category_id,e.subcategory_id,c.name AS "category_name?",s.name AS "subcategory_name?",date_trunc('month',e.entry_date)::date AS "month!",sum(e.amount)::numeric AS "amount!" FROM ledger_entries e LEFT JOIN categories c ON c.household_id=e.household_id AND c.id=e.category_id LEFT JOIN categories s ON s.household_id=e.household_id AND s.id=e.subcategory_id WHERE e.household_id=$1 AND e.status='actual' AND e.direction='expense' AND e.owner_scope=ANY($2) AND ((e.entry_date >= $3 AND e.entry_date < $4) OR (e.entry_date >= $5 AND e.entry_date < $6)) GROUP BY e.category_id,e.subcategory_id,c.name,s.name,date_trunc('month',e.entry_date)
